properties.name: Land outside Canada
properties.source: Canada edge: Statistics Canada 2021 provinces/territories digital boundary file (Open Government Licence - Canada). Within 0.75 degrees of Canada: OpenStreetMap land polygons (osmdata.openstreetmap.de, ODbL), ~100 m along the US border belt, ~300 m on the Alaska and Greenland coasts. Beyond: Natural Earth admin-0 countries, 1:50m north of 35N and 1:10m south (public domain).
